options.query:
index=ms_entra_id (sourcetype="microsoft:applications")
| spath input=_raw path=id output=obj_id
| spath input=_raw path=appId output=app_id
| spath input=_raw path=displayName output=app_name
| eval k = sourcetype . "::" . obj_id
| stats latest(_raw) AS raw latest(app_name) AS app_name latest(app_id) as app_id BY k
| spath input=raw path=keyCredentials{}.keyId output=key_id
| spath input=raw path=keyCredentials{}.endDateTime output=end_raw
| eval z = mvzip(key_id, end_raw, "|~|")
| mvexpand z
| eval p = split(z, "|~|"), key_id = mvindex(p,0), end_raw = mvindex(p,1)
| eval ts = replace(end_raw, "[.][0-9]+", "")
| eval exp = coalesce(strptime(ts,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"), strptime(ts,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"))
| where exp >= now() AND exp <= now() + (30 * 86400)
| eval expires_at = strftime(exp,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
| eval days_remaining = round((exp - now()) / 86400, 1)
| table app_name app_id key_id expires_at days_remaining
| sort days_remaining

    AND exclude_agent_instance=0
    AND exclude_agent_app=0
